name: Stage 1 stuck rule (frozen before round 1; eval plan amendment a7b336b and R&D's final ruling, 2026-10-10)
rule: An answer is stuck when any of these holds:
(A) the same 8-word span appears 3 or more times in the thinking trace;

(C) the thinking is long AND its re-read rate is above the baseline: long = thinking tokens > max(the tier's p95 below, 2 x the item's own target thinking tokens in its arm); re-read rate = re-reads per 1,000 thinking tokens; baseline below.
Length over the p95 and over 2x the target are recorded on every observation, never triggers on their own.
Detection is passive (it reads a finished answer) and applies to training-time questions only (the quiz ledger and rehearsals), never to DEV, sealed or pre-interview sittings.

definitions.quote: a material line is quoted where any 5 consecutive words of it appear in the trace (the whole line if shorter, at least 3 words), after lenient normalising (case folded; **, __, backticks and straight/curly quotes removed; punctuation dropped); a 5-word window shared by two or more material lines is not counted; hits on one line within 5 words of each other are one quote
definitions.re-read: a quote of a material line already quoted earlier in the same trace
definitions.material: the item's material plus the new_material brought by earlier turns

p95_pooling.1, 2, 7+: all tiers pooled (not covered by DEV), n 102

reread_baseline_provenance.source: untrained pilot-30 baseline traces, seeds 0-2 (no sealed data)

dropped_before_freezing.branch: not progressing = no new material line first quoted in the final 30% of the trace
dropped_before_freezing.why: it held for almost every trace, so (C) would have collapsed to 'long'
